hook: the full moon in gemini is coming. here's where it lands for your sign
wheelNote: real positions at the exact moment: moon at 2°20′ gemini, sun opposite at 2°20′ sagittarius

signs.text: a conversation you've been avoiding finally happens. the text gets sent, or answered.
a money moment: a bill, a raise, a 'what am i worth' talk. don't undersell yourself.
it's your full moon. you see yourself clearly, maybe for the first time this year. say what you want.
quiet and emotional for you. dreams get loud. close a chapter in private, no announcement needed.
group plans peak and you'll see who really shows up for you. keep those ones close.
work spotlight. effort from the last six months gets noticed. ask for what you earned.
you're done with the routine. a trip, a course, a big new idea: say yes to one of them.
deep stuff comes up: trust, intimacy, shared money. let go of what you've been gripping.
a partner, a deal, a 'where is this going'. the other person finally shows their cards.
your body wants a reset. sleep, food, one small habit: fix one thing and the week changes.
a crush gets obvious. flirt, create, do something just because it's fun.
home and family take center stage. old feelings resurface. rest more than you think you need.

cta:
this is for your sun sign. read your rising too: it often fits even better.
